commands.name: search-datasets
commands.summary: Search the data.cdc.gov catalog by keyword, with optional category/tag/type filters, sort order and paging

commands.name: list-categories
commands.summary: List all dataset categories on data.cdc.gov with their dataset counts

commands.name: list-tags
commands.summary: List the most-used dataset tags on data.cdc.gov with their counts

commands.name: autocomplete-datasets
commands.summary: Suggest dataset titles that match a partial search term

commands.name: get-dataset
commands.summary: Get full metadata for one dataset by its 4x4 id, including columns, field names, data types and stats

commands.name: get-dataset-metadata
commands.summary: Get a dataset's catalog metadata: tags, contact info, custom fields, ISO update dates and API/web URIs

commands.name: query-rows
commands.summary: Query a dataset's rows with SoQL (SODA API): filter, full-text search, select/aggregate, group, sort and page

commands.name: run-soql-query
commands.summary: Run a full SoQL query string against a dataset through the v3 query API, e.g. 'select jurisdiction, sum(influenza_deaths) group by jurisdiction limit 10'

commands.name: export-rows
commands.summary: Download a dataset export in JSON: view metadata under meta, rows as positional arrays under data

commands.name: get-data-catalog
commands.summary: Get the full DCAT (Project Open Data) catalog of every public dataset on data.cdc.gov
